home.headline: A free, bilingual platform for consumer behaviour research
home.lede: Build anything from a simple questionnaire to an interactive experiment, run it with participants in Arabic or English, and export clean data for analysis. No fees, no institutional licence, no code.

questionnaires.title: Questionnaires
questionnaires.body: Twelve question types, attention checks and reusable blocks, arranged in any order you choose.

experiments.title: Media experiments
experiments.body: Show images, video and audio with exposure control. Conditions, shopping environments and online shops are on the roadmap.

bilingual.title: Arabic and English
bilingual.body: Right-to-left and left-to-right done properly, for both researchers and participants.

export.title: Clean exports
export.body: One row per participant, a codebook with Arabic and English labels, and the exact study version used.

free.title: Free, always
free.body: No subscriptions, no paid tiers, no selling of participant data. Designed to be self-hosted by universities.

home.footer: A research tool, not a commercial product. Limits exist only to keep the free service stable and are explained in the documentation.

export.note: Files are UTF-8 with Arabic intact. In R use readr::read_csv(); in Python use pandas.read_csv(encoding="utf-8-sig"). SPSS syntax and the event log arrive in Phase 2.
